subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should a workflow/security owner approve the fourteen pinned third-party GitHub Action revisions for this exact PR head, including the revisions used in token-bearing dispatch, release, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it changes executable supply-chain inputs in privileged GitHub Actions paths; that acceptance cannot be inferred from the version bump or ordinary repository tests.

options.title: Review and approve the exact action revisions
options.body: Verify the upstream revision provenance and release changes for privileged workflow call sites, then merge only after required checks pass on the current head.

options.title: Split out sensitive action upgrades
options.body: Keep the low-risk automation updates separate and submit token-bearing, release, and agent action upgrades for focused security-owner review.

recommendation.title: Review and approve the exact action revisions
recommendation.body: Verify the upstream revision provenance and release changes for privileged workflow call sites, then merge only after required checks pass on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: No more specific workflow-history owner was available in the supplied context, while repository policy makes this an owner-level security-boundary decision.
